# Aether UI

> Aether UI is a premium open-code design system for SaaS dashboards and admin interfaces.
> Registry format is compatible with shadcn/ui. Use the `aether-ui` CLI to install components.

## Quick Start

```bash
npx aether-ui init          # initialise project, creates aether.json
npx aether-ui list          # browse available components
npx aether-ui add button    # install a component
npx aether-ui generate "build me a SaaS dashboard"  # AI-driven scaffolding
```

## Documentation

- Full docs: https://aetherui.dev
- Registry API: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/registry.json
- AI usage guide: https://aetherui.dev/llms
- Tokens reference: https://aetherui.dev/tokens
- Component reference: https://aetherui.dev/components

## Architecture

Aether UI uses a four-layer architecture:
1. **Primitives** (registry:ui) — foundational components for forms, layout, and interaction
2. **Patterns** (registry:pattern) — higher-level compositions of primitives
3. **Blocks** (registry:block) — full page-section assemblies
4. **Tokens** — design tokens for colors, spacing, typography, and more

## Primitives (16)

## Badge
- Name: badge
- Install: aether-ui add badge
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/badge.json
- Intent: Display a small inline label for status, category, or count
  Slots: children
  Often used with: button, card, table, metric-card
  Prompts: add a status badge | show a label pill | display a count indicator

## Button
- Name: button
- Install: aether-ui add button
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/button.json
- Intent: Trigger an action or navigate; supports multiple visual styles and sizes
  Slots: children, asChild
  Often used with: form-field, dialog, card, page-header, empty-state
  Prompts: add a button | create a submit button | add a call to action

## Card
- Name: card
- Install: aether-ui add card
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/card.json
- Intent: Group related content in a visually distinct surface container
  Slots: CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter
  Often used with: metric-card, login-block, signup-block, section-header
  Prompts: add a card | create a content card | add a panel with a title and description

## Checkbox
- Name: checkbox
- Install: aether-ui add checkbox
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/checkbox.json
- Intent: Allow the user to check or uncheck a boolean option
  Slots: checked, onCheckedChange
  Often used with: form-field, label, login-block

## Patterns (9)

## Empty State
- Name: empty-state
- Install: aether-ui add empty-state
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/empty-state.json
- Intent: Show a helpful empty-view when a list or collection has no data yet
  Slots: icon, title, description, action
  Often used with: button, card
  Prompts: add an empty state | show a no results message | add a zero-data placeholder

## Error State
- Name: error-state
- Install: aether-ui add error-state
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/error-state.json
- Intent: Communicate a data-loading or network failure and offer a retry action
  Slots: title, description, onRetry
  Often used with: button
  Prompts: add an error state | show an error message with a retry button | add a fetch error fallback

## Form Field

  Slots: FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, children
  Often used with: input, textarea, select, checkbox, switch, label

- Name: dashboard-shell
- Install: aether-ui add dashboard-shell

  Often used with: nav, metric-card, table-toolbar, table, page-header
  Prompts: build me a SaaS dashboard | add a dashboard layout | create an admin panel shell

- Install: aether-ui add login-block

  Slots: onSubmit, onForgotPassword, footer

  Prompts: add a login page | create an authentication screen | add a sign-in form

## Sign Up
- Name: signup-block
- Install: aether-ui add signup-block
- Source: https://registry.aetherui.dev/r/signup-block.json
- Intent: Ready-made sign-up page block with name, email, password validation, and terms acceptance
  Slots: onSubmit, onSignIn, footer

  Prompts: add a sign up page | create a registration form | add a new account form

## Compose a SaaS Dashboard

To build a standard SaaS dashboard, install these items in order:

```bash
npx aether-ui add dashboard-shell   # full-page layout with sidebar and topbar
npx aether-ui add metric-card       # KPI cards for the overview
npx aether-ui add table-toolbar     # search + filter above data tables
npx aether-ui add table             # data table
npx aether-ui add page-header       # page titles with breadcrumbs
npx aether-ui add empty-state       # zero-data fallbacks
npx aether-ui add loading-state     # async loading indicators
npx aether-ui add error-state       # fetch error fallbacks
```

## Compose an Authentication Flow

```bash
npx aether-ui add login-block       # email + password login
npx aether-ui add signup-block      # registration form
```

## Token-Driven Styling

All components consume CSS custom properties from `@aetherstack/tokens`.
Override the design system by redefining tokens in your global CSS:

```css
:root {
  --color-primary: 220 90% 56%;
  --radius: 0.5rem;
}
```
